svg.title: Composite residual gain compared between standard ResNet and unconstrained Hyper-Connections at 27B scale.
svg.desc: A bar chart of Amax Gain, the largest row or column sum of the composite residual map: standard ResNet holds at 1 times because its residual coefficient is fixed, while unconstrained Hyper-Connections at 27B scale peaks near 3000 times, a level the paper associates with unstable training.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Amax Gain: the largest row or column sum of the composite residual map across all layers.
